desc: The Blackhawk® revolver is regarded as the finest, most advanced single-action revolver ever made. Designed and engineered for use with powerful, modern centerfire revolver cartridges. Components are made from hardened chrome alloy steel. Traditional western-style, hand-filling grip. Target-grade accuracy with ramp front and adjustable rear sights. Available in a variety of calibers, barrel length, grips, finish and weight.
